description: The player takes the role of the heroine, Lucia Nicol, a girl who's trapped in a weird situation after she made a wish which turned into bad fortune.

title: Magical Battle Arena: Complete Form
description:
Magical Battle Arena is a crossover third-person shooter game developed by Fly-System in 2008. The game features characters from Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha, Magic Knight Rayearth, Cardcaptor Sakura, Slayers, and Mahoujin Guru Guru.

A stand-alone version of the base game and previous expansions was published by Area-Zero as Magical Battle Arena: Complete.

title: Hex Tetris
description: A Tetris inspired game for Windows 3.1 that uses blocks created out of hexagons, rather than squares.

title: Jet de GO! Let's Go By Airliner
description: Jet de GO! is a spin-off from the famous Densha de GO! series by Taito. Instead of trains, this title focus exclusively on flying planes. Players can take off and land with a Jetstream 31 turboprop, a mid-range Boeing 767 or a long haul Boeing 747. The game modes include Flight mode, Cruise mode and Lesson mode.

title: Rayman Designer
description: Rayman Designer is an expansion of the original installment with new levels that can be created or downloaded online.

title: Rayman Activity Center
description: Rayman Activity Center is an educational video game published by Ubisoft for the PC. It is a spin-off of the original Rayman game, and aims at children.

title: Halloween: Trick or Treat 2
description: Horror-themed mini-games from Virtual Playground.

title: Delicious 2 Deluxe
description: Emily's back for more delicious fun in this fast-paced sequel! Uncle Antonio needs Emily's help to get out of a financial fix. Help Emily rescue her family's finances in five all-new restaurants, each with a unique menu and theme. Use your earnings to purchase decorations sure to make your customers smile. Emily's friends and family are on hand to help, but it's going to take your serving savvy to get Uncle Antonio back on track. Featuring two game modes, all-new customers, and hours of fast family fun, Delicious 2 is just the thing to satisfy your craving for fun.

title: One Late Night
description:
One Late Night is a short immersive horror-game experience, starring an unnamed graphic designer employee, working late one night at the office, until strange things start to happen. 
 
The basic idea is that players who have been in similar situations, and worked with similar office jobs, will relate themselves to the game setting and scenario and become immersed. Even if you can't relate to the game storyline, you will still get a good experience. The storyline is presented with short monologues, displaying the thoughts of the player, as you need to perform certain tasks to proceed in the game to continue discover new clues about what's going on.

title: Hoshizora no Memoria -Eternal Heart-
description:
The fandisc for Hoshizora no Memoria.

It contains addition story routes as a sequel to complete the Yume and Mare routes of Hoshizora no Memoria, as well as an additional side story for the other heroines of the game.

The HD rerelease of Hoshizora no Memoria includes this fan-disc.

title: Mystic Formula
description: Shooting action game from Micro Cabin, released only in Japan for the TurboGrafx-CD/PC Engine.

title: Go! Go! Birdie Chance
description: Developed by HuneX, Go! Go! Birdie Chance is an anime-style golf game released only in Japan for the PC Engine.

title: Platdude in Battling Ostriches
description: Jayenkai's 8-bit-ish mascot takes to the skies on flying ostriches in this deathmatch battle game.

title: Sammy Suricate
description: The game combines elements of logic and skill, but it also contains levels of training. As Sammy Suricate, we need to collect all the gems and avoid hostile lions.

title: Wildlife Zoo
description: Wildlife Park 2 is a sequel to Wildlife Park, first released in 2006, and published by B-Alive. It was developed by Deep Silver exclusively for the PC.

title: Cipher for Windows
description: A puzzle game for Windows 3.1 where players must solve substitution ciphers of well-known quotes.

title: Natsuki Chronicles
description:
New dramatic horizontal shoot ’em up that takes place in the same setting as Ginga Force. An immersive story that follows protagonist Natsuki. Discover the story of her past as a rookie pilot up to present day with events that are parallel to those in Ginga Force.

– Story Mode alternating between past and present over 10+ stages
– Arcade Mode for quick action with Online Leaderboards
– Huge selection of customization with combinations of three weapon types, like in its predecessor Ginga Force
– A wide variety of equipment can be found throughout the game, making for added replay value as players add to their collection.
– "Bullet Trajectory Display" function, You can observe the direction of enemy bullets!

title: Loco Mania
description: A puzzle game where you dispatch trains as seamlessly as possible.

title: Air Battles: Sky Defender
description: Flight simulation game for the PC where you fly planes into combat.

title: In the Kingdom
description: A deliberately retro horror FPS.

title: My First Amazing World Explorer
description: My First Amazing World Explorer is an educational travel game, developed and published by DK Multimedia. It functions both as a virtual atlas and as an exploration tool. The player travels the world, collecting stamps from every country visited, whilst learning about different nations.

title: Cultris II
description: Cultris II is the sequel to Cultris. It is a PC based online multiplayer tetromino game, similar to Tetris, available as a free download. It is known for its Timer-based combo system, which makes it an extremely fast-paced game. You can play games over the internet as well as several singleplayer modes.

title: DarkStorm
description: Play as MARS (Machine of Absolute Retaliation and Safeguard), a robot programmed to exterminate the treacherous aliens who have taken over Razor City. As MARS, you must free Razor City from its domination in order to save the survivors from their doom.

title: Kenka Bancho: Zenkoku Seiha
description: Kenka Bancho: Zenkoku Seiha is a social game in the Kenka Bancho franchise for smart phones, "feature phones", and PC.

title: Death Tales
description: Embark on an adventure as a new Reaper who has gone rogue! Collect equipment and spells, learn powerful attacks against hordes of enemies, complete quests for a cast of quirky characters, and make difficult choices in this grim yet richly illustrated 2D world. Play alone or with a friend in local co-op and serve Death together!

title: Austrian Truck Simulator
description: In this standalone add-on to the German Truck Simulator, players get to deliver their cargo across Austria.

title: Meriwether: An American Epic
description: An RPG where players take on the role of Captain Meriwether Lewis during his famous expedition from the Mississippi River to the Coast

title: Witchmarsh
description:
An action RPG set in 1920s Massachusetts. Create and manage a team of investigators in a story-driven supernatural mystery.
It's the roaring twenties! Join an unlikely team of detectives as they charge headlong into the darkest corners of rural America. Their mission: find and return twelve missing townsfolk who vanished under mysterious circumstances.

A handsome reward is in store should they succeed, but with the supernatural lurking around every corner, will any of them live long enough to collect it?

title: Phenomenon: City of Cyan
description: A hidden object/puzzle game.

title: Project Tilt
description: A fast-paced multiplayer 2D Shooter, with crazy weapons power-ups and levels, available for free on web and PC.

title: Phenomenon: Outcome
description: The third entry in the Phenomenon hidden object/puzzle series.

title: The Next Penelope: Race to Odysseus
description: Inspired by Greek mythology and Anime series alike, Penelope is a top-down action racing game developed solely by Aurelien Regard.

title: Bam 'N Jam
description: Bam 'N Jam is a simplistic music puzzle game for Windows.

title: Renai 0 Kilometer
description: "Love 0 Kilometers" is a novel game with choices. The ending will change depending on the choices you make. Through a limited-time family swap, the protagonist spends time with his childhood friend, deepening his relationship with a cute girl and enjoying special conversations.

description: An isometric, tactical Turn-Based RPG set in a supernatural post-Apocalyptic world where Heaven & Hell have merged with Earth

title: Mimicry Man
description: A mimic tasked with defeating the Hero by the Dark Lord just because, Mimicry Man will have to use his one technique: show people what they want and ambush! A cleverly written puzzle game having the player present, collect, and combine items to complete the story.

description: The Mirror Mysteries is a hidden object game.

Journey through time and space to learn the secrets of Osiris, avert a dark future, and rebuild the ties between the legendary Warlock and his greatest student - Ikora Rey.

title: Dark Parables: Goldilocks and the Fallen Star - Collector's Edition
description: Who is trying to destroy the Kingdom of Barsia?

title: Stone Flower
description: Five Boom-compatible maps based around an earthy, green-and-brown texture theme, and design mostly inspired by Ribbiks' earlier work. Starts with tiny sandbox maps in MAP01 and 02, ramps up the difficulty with combat﻿-puzzle stuff in MAP03 and 04 and builds up to a slaughter finale in MAP05.

title: Battle of Frigates
description:
Have you ever played in Tanks in dendy? What if the battles took place at sea? Before you there is an ideological continuation - Battle of Frigates.
Battle of Frigates – fun top down shooter where you are in the role of a frigate are fighting on the water, your enemies - the hostile enemy frigates, their bosses, guns, mines. A variety of tasks, such as searching for the treasure, saving all the victims or defeating your enemies.

title: Spiiiders
description: The Marina Killing Machine, John Iron. That's you, follow him on his latest mega-giga-ultimate-action mission, fighting against monster spiders. The world needs you!

title: Walking Heavy
description: Walking Heavy is a 2D isometric stealth shooter / RPG where players take on the role of a nameless hitman who takes to the streets to curb the sales of a mysterious new drug known only as HYPE.

title: Cicadas
description: Cicadas is an indie adventure galgame about sweet young high school romance. The haunting story is brought to you as visual novel, with beautiful music and voice acting. Interact with pretty girls to push the story forward.

title: SnappleNoid
description:
Help Snapple save the forest! 
In the new adventure, our hero will throw an apple ball into bad animals. 
Are you ready?

title: HellTown
description: The year is 1959, you just got a job as a postman in a brand new town called Little Vale. Although the sun is shining and the birds are chirping, this town is shrouded in mystery. Something… unnatural is afoot here.

title: Crazy Mob
description: Crazy Mob is 2 GAMES IN 1: DEFENSE AND RUNER WITH MONSTERS THAT MAY GO ON THE CEILING!

title: Ambush Tactics
description: Red Cloud, a shadow, struggles to survive and keep Centralia from falling into chaos in this epic tactics RPG.

title: Steam Tactics
description: Welcome aboard your airship, captain! Engage in tactical combats, upgrade your ships and weapons, level up your pilots.

title: Little Adventurer II
description: Third-person 3D casual games.which is suitable for people of all ages.Control your little adventurer to help NPC find his items.Knock down the little monster.Or you need to start again.

title: Tank Warz!
description:
Tank Warz! is an arcade shooter with a modern look and feel, featuring fast paced tank battles with enemies that wish to prevent you from fulfilling your mission.

Your mission is simple: Destroy the enemy Spawn Portals to stop the evil tank invasion whilst battling your way through different terrains and big bosses.

Featuring pickup items such as Health Packs and "Insta-Bombs" (dropped at random when an enemy tank is destroyed) to help (or sometimes hinder!) you in your mission. Additionally featuring an energetic rock backing track and an old-school look, Tank Warz! will engross you in hours of arcade fun.

title: Tactics 2: War
description:
Tactics 2: War.
This is a real-time strategy, combined with a shooter of an airplane, a tank, a rocket launcher, a ship and a submarine. 
Modern warfare.

title: Torej: Red Cubes
description: Torej: Red Cubes is a puzzle game where the goal is to build a tower the way it reaches and touches all the red cubes in the polygon without it collapsing and falling of the platform. You can play different styles like building as high as you can or trying to make a stable construction. Every one of them is fine as long as you don't break your creation.

title: Far from Noise
description: Far from Noise is a narrative set on the edge of a cliff, where two characters discuss what it means to balance between life and death.

title: Suicide Adventures
description: Lost in the abyssal depths of limbo, you are a tortured soul who is trapped between life and death, stuck in a dungeon whose puzzles will test you as you strive to go into the afterlife.

title: Waste Cleaner
description:
Waste, what could be worse, but someone has to solve this problem? 
Use the liquid to flush out the debris, detect invisible obstacles, build up protrusions and get to inaccessible places. Find other possibilities for using fluid in a first-person logical game with fluid simulation.

title: Apocalypse: The Game
description: Apocalypse is the upcoming survival built entirely by one developer, with a growing community, the apocalypse focuses on singleplayer apocalyptic survival, with all of the latest graphics technologies integrated together such as PhysX 3, Vulkan API and DirectX 12, built and funded by the community!

title: Thief Simulator
description: Become the best thief. Gather intel, steal things and sell them to buy hi-tech equipement. Do everything that a real thief does.

title: The Walking Vegetables
description:
It's the 1980's and an evil alien race has invaded Earth, turning all vegetables into crawling, bawling, mauling abominations. You are about to join Department Radical, the grooviest police force on Earth.
Are you a rad enough dude or dame to smite these ravenous creatures?

title: Touch My Spinner
description: It's just a clicker idle game. Rotate your fidget spinners, earn coins, do upgrades, open chests, buy new spinners, earn more coins and buy more new spinners.

title: Monster Partner
description: This is a capture monster, cultivate monsters, monsters against the game.The game has no end. Each strange partner has its own characteristics, composed of different teams to play a different strength. And NPC team can fight together. Can capture all the blame to fill the illustrations.

title: Gurugedara
description: Guru Gedara is a leading platform for interacting with the teachers and students. Meet friends and attend classes in a virtual environment.

title: Temple of Aluxes
description:
Have you ever wanted to explore a lost temple? This is your chance.
Find the treasures and escape the Temple of Aluxes by solving various puzzles and challenges.

title: Sacralith: The Archer's Tale
description: Sacralith: The Archer's Tale is a breathtaking story of an archer in a world of dark magic and Inquisition. Don't let your magic abilities to play trick on you - even an invisible warrior may be tracked , so this adventure promises to be the hardest one..

title: Akatsuki: Shisei Ichi-go
description: Akatsuki Prototyp 1, also known as Akatsuki Shisei Ichigō in Japan, is a Japanese-exclusive dōjin 2D fighting game, developed by the dōjin circle SUBTLE STYLE for Microsoft Windows. It is a prototype version of Akatsuki Blitzkampf prior to being retitled and finalized.

title: Zwei!!: The Arges Adventure
description: Boasting a completely standalone story set on a mysterious “low fantasy” island floating amongst the clouds, Zwei: The Arges Adventure plays out as a classically styled action-oriented 2D dungeon crawler with oodles of optional content and unlockables, player-defined challenge through a unique food-based experience system, and a pervading tongue-in-cheek humor style that helps set it apart from other entries in the genre.

title: Rabbids Big Bang
description: The raving rabbids are headed to space!

title: Glo
description: Enter a realm shrouded in darkness and take a leap of blind faith as you try to find a way out. GLO is a simple and rewarding puzzle platformer with an daunting central mechanic – nearly everything that stands between you and your goal is obscured and invisible. Using only the light around you and the glow of your projectiles, you must rely on memory to guide you through the obstacles and hazards that you glimpse. Find reassurance and enlightenment in the messages written on the dark walls, illuminated as you progress and hinting at an emotional story. This is a beautiful and abstract journey across 100 levels, featuring precision controls and an atmospheric soundtrack to drive curiosity and stave off fear of the unknown. It’s minimalistic yet metaphorical, hidden yet ripe for discovery. Will you unlock its secrets?

title: Hanayaka Nari, Waga Ichizoku
description:
When her father fell sick, Asagi Haru has to help support her family. She quits her job at the factory and starts looking for a new job. That’s when she bumpes into Egawa Chitomi and Arita Kisuke, who are looking for a new maid for the Miyanomori family. Haru applied for the job on the spot, leaving her hometown to work in their mansion in Tokyo. She thought working as a maid would be fun.. until she meets the six Miyanomori brothers.

The brothers each have different mothers, all divorced from their father — the head of the family, Miyanomori Genichirou. Being born in a big family, most of the brothers treat Haru like crap. They call her trash and view her as a lowly servant who doesn’t have any right to talk back to them. Not to mention Tae, her new tsundere friend there, keeps lying and gets her in trouble. Haru quickly realized that her new job isn’t by any means easy, but she needs to work hard for her family.

Not too long after Haru starts working there, Genichirou announced to his sons that he’s retiring soon and he’s making a game to determine who will be the next head. The brothers have to entertain him and collect points. The first one who reached ten points will be the new head, and they have until March to please their father. This is the reason why the brothers all have different mothers: Genichirou wants to put them into a battle for the position.

title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective - The Case of the Serial Shaver
description: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective, based on the movie of the same name, is a humorous 3rd-person point-and-click adventure in a cartoon-inspired style, with multiple paths and endings. In the game you take on the role of Ace, who's out to solve a case involving endangered animals and who has to uncover the identity of the sicko with the scissors. You and your pet monkey Spike will explore dozens of locations, ranging from the Alaskan Tundra to the Bavarian castle of Phatteus Lardus. You will race in a high-tech snowmobile, rub noses with Eskimo maidens and go where no sane Pet Detective has gone before. You'll need to use everything at your disposal to fend off your enemies and animal haters to eventually return all the animals to their rightful homes.

title: Idle Bouncer
description: Make the balls jump, upgrade and change the world! Drop the balls to generate energy with each bounce. Upgrade available balls and buy new ones to generate even more energy. Sell your balls empire to get meta-energy to change the world!

title: One Night You're Crazy
description: It's like playing tag. Where you collect bloody teddy bear parts. While avoiding a flesh eating wolf. Or maybe you'll be the wolf. I don't care either way.

title: Desert Racer
description: Are you a good driver? A game to test your reaction speed. The player controls a car, the speed of which is gradually increasing. It is necessary to turn and collect gasoline cans in time.

title: Demon's Tier+
description: Demon's Tier+ is a dungeon-RPG roguelike with arcade and adventure elements. Enter the dungeons of King Thosgar and destroy his demonic minions! Combining the best elements from Xenon Valkyrie+ and Riddled Corpses EX, this is the latest game in the Diabolical Mind trilogy!

title: Keyboard Killers
description: Keyboard Killers is not simple keyboard clicker game. In which you should kill meteors to save your starship and your friend dragon (^-^) . You should be very fast to able to complete the game. More then 500 apm on hardest levels !!!

title: The New California
description:
Healty fun with defunct bones!

Tubiacanga, 1910. A Rio de Janeiro small city lives the most disgusting crime of it's history: the defunct's bones theft!

title: Ocean Rift
description: Ocean Rift is the world's first VR aquatic safari park. Explore a vivid underwater world full of life including dolphins, sharks, orcas, turtles, sea snakes, rays, manatees, sea lions, whales, and even dinosaurs!

title: Within Whispers: The Fall
description: Dive into the character of young woman stricken by the horrors of the war and is trying to find her missing brother while she is struggling with her “gift”. She can see and communicate with ghosts of dead soldiers. But she is hoping that there is only one ghost that she will never meet.

title: Druid's Tale: Crystal Cave
description: RPG game with crafting elements. Become a Druid that is protecting your land from darkness. Make potions, poisons and even alcohol. Trade your products with neutral factions and fight the forces of darkness. The game emphasizes new solutions that have not been applied anywhere else!

title: Rayman 3: Hoodlum Havoc Print Studio
description: Add your favorite Hoodlum Havoc characters and scenes from the Rayman world, to create your own calendars, writing paper and cards. You can choose from a variety of backgrounds, stamps and borders.

title: Mode
description: Mode is a surreal interactive FMV game in which players crash a private art event thrown by the enigmatic Vito Brevis, and attempt to solve the mysteries surrounding both the MODE event and Vito himself.

title: M3 Sono Kuroki Hagane: Mission Memento Mori
Pioneer
description: This is a game of [Third-person Action Combat]. The characters possess powerful [Add-ons], unique [Sets], distinctive [Swordsmanship], and strong [MODs]! You will play as a [Pioneer], combine your own [BD], and wipe out the enemy camp completely! Raise your blade! Embrace the glory of the warrior!

title: Secret of Evangelion
description:
An RPG/adventure retelling the end of the Evangelion storyline, introducing the new characters NERV investigator Kenzaki Kyouya and dummy-plug research scientist Kaga Hitomi.

In the game, you play as a new character, Nerv agent Kyouya Kenzaki, an old college friend of Kaji's. Throughout the game, you must uncover mysteries surrounding the Evangelion plot, as well as mysteries involving yourself. There are multiple routes, which seem to depend how much information you uncover. The end credits, which scroll like Evangelion Death, features a backdrop of the LCL Sea from End of Evangelion set to Soul's Refrain (10th Anniversary Version) from Evangelion: Decade.

title: Shinseiki Evangelion: Typing E-Keikaku
description: Shinseiki Evangelion: Typing E-Keikaku is a typing tutor game based on the anime Shinseiki Evangelion ("Neon Genesis" Evangelion)

description: A hidden object game from SpinTop Games.

title: Vacation Quest: The Hawaiian Islands
description: A hidden object game in the Vacation Quest series.

title: Amazing Adventures: The Forgotten Dynasty
description: A hidden object game in the Amazing Adventures franchise.

title: Maleficent Free Fall
description: Maleficent Free Fall is a match puzzle game based on the Disney motion picture starring Angelina Jolie.

title: Alliance: Future Combat
description: A RTS for PC that is set in the far flung future of 2008

title: Glorious Leader
description: Developed by Moneyhorse Games out of Atlanta for both PC and mobile platforms, Glorious Leader is a satirical retro-style action platformer starring dubious North Korean dictator Kim Jong-Un.

title: Soushuu Senshinkan Gakuen Hachimyoujin
description:
Yoshiya has been seeing continuous lucid dreams every night since he was small. Even though his mind doesn’t get to rest during his ‘sleep’, he still doesn’t experience heavy fatigue nor have ill health. Instead, he is brighter and more capable than other people his age. He thought of his special ability as one of his good points, and intended to live a relatively normal life. That was until he met Mizuki, who also had the same ability as him.

They were able to enter the dream world at will, but soon they found themselves caught in a world which could kill people and change history. It was a world from which one cannot escape. They were faced with the choice of either giving up and taking their own lives or to charge forward and try to break through this nightmare. However, they all felt like they were not caught up in this absurd situation by chance, but rather because it was their own wishes.

title: The Cube
description: The Cube is an MMO RPG shooter. A giant, levitating Cube with rotating rows and edges. Hidden within is an unknown equation capable of altering the laws of reality. Can you survive another turn?

title: Hapax
description: Isolated from Earth, you alone must solve the mysteries of a derelict alien vessel and find your way home.

title: Kiss Bell
description: Visual novel about a teenager who joins the the girl dominated school volunteer Christmas club to make up for causing trouble at an earlier event.

title: Son of Scoregasm
description: Sequel to indie dual-stick shooter Scoregasm.

title: Marvel Avengers Alliance Tactics
description: Marvel Avengers Alliance Tactics is a tactics RPG spin-off of the popular Facebook/mobile social RPG.

title: Monster Hunter Frontier G3
description: Season 3 of Monster Hunter Frontier G.

title: Poker Superstars: Invitational Tournament
description: A poker game for the PC

title: Monster Hunter Frontier G2
description: Season 2 of Monster Hunter Frontier G.

title: Monster Hunter Frontier G5
description: A new version of the Monster Hunter MMO spin-off, Fronter G5.

title: Frozen Bubble
description: Frozen Bubble is a puzzle game that started out on Linux and has later been ported to other systems.

title: To Leave
description: This is an indie platformer about a boy who seeks to leave his old life behind using a magical flying door. To Leave features challenging puzzle-platformer levels that will test your puzzle-solving skills through an emotionally gripping story. The game addresses depression - a state of mind that tempts you to open any doors if they allow you to leave everything behind... sometimes for a moment... sometimes for life.

title: MilkSnake
description: A snake game for Mac OS X, played on continuous non-euclidean surfaces.

title: Make It Rain: The Love of Money
description: Make it Rain: The Love of The Money is a swiper game, where you have to invest your money in the best way to get richer then get richer and then be very very rich. Be a business manager and success in your investments! Or otherwise, die in the process and start again to amass a lot of cash!

title: Pixel Noir
description: Untangle a gripping conspiracy in this noir-influenced mystery, laced with classic RPG elements. Navigate seedy streets to collect clues, upgrade skills and customize weapons. Brawl in turn-based combat with timed hits & combos, to reveal the dark truth that plagues the city’s core and your sanity.

title: 20,000 Leagues Above the Clouds
description: Captain your airship across the skies in this project from That Brain.

title: Project Legion
description: Immerse yourself in terrifying dreams and unravel mysteries playing alone or with friends. Confront supernatural horrors, survive terrifying enemies, and complete various missions to solve the cases.

title: Smash team
description: Multiplayer arenas with different game modes.

title: Total Pro Football
description: This is a football sim for the PC.

title: Total Pro Basketball
description: A basketball sim for the PC released in 2003

title: Apache Longbow Assault
description:
Apache Longbow Assault is a helicopter simulator for the AH-64 Apache Longbow variant and the follow-up to AH-64 Apache Air Assault. Similar to the previous game it is a mix of a simulation and arcade so players can start right away. The in-game cockpit then serves largely as a reference frame rather than complex manipulation by the player. 
 
The only game mode is a linear campaign that consists of about 30 missions. They take place during different times of day, weather and over varied terrain, including mountains, beaches and seas. It features head-to-head fights with other helicopters, attacking AA batteries, ships and ground vehicles, rescue operations and defense missions. Before starting the mission, a loadout can be defined as it is possible to run out of ammo. Weapons include Hydra rockets, Hellfire missiles and a M230 cannon. Optionally automatic targeting can be enabled. There is a night vision view and flares can be launched to assist the ground operations.

title: Grabbles
description: Networked multiplayer action game for Mac OS Classic. Players fight each other or cooperate while killing all the Greebles in each stage to advance.

title: Redline: Xtreme Air Racing 2
description: A flight racing simulator for the PC

title: The History Channel: Battle of Britain - World War II 1940
description: A flight combat game that takes place during the Battle of Britain in 1940, World War II

title: Brutal Nature
description: Brutal Nature is a 3d survival game with voxel mining and smooth terrain featuring a realistic and in depth crafting system with over 500 recipes.

title: Endless Skater
description: Flip, Grab, and Grind your way to the longest runs and highest scores in Endless Skater! Air it out on ramps, across rails and even over the rooftops! Choose from five of the top professionals to ever set foot on a skateboard and jump into endless levels that challenge you to get as far as you can, or score as many points as you can. Discover dozens of tricks and combos - including secret, hidden signature tricks. Go for huge air, long grinds, and big flips! But watch out...you can also take some huge spills!

title: Where's My Water? Featuring XYY
description: Where's My Water? Featuring XYY is a spin-off of the popular water physics game, starring a character from a popular Chinese cartoon.

title: Ultima X: Odyssey
description:
Ultima X: Odyssey was the planned sequel to Ultima IX: Ascension. The game would have been the series second MMORPG, aiming to bring Ultima to the Everquest crowd. It was set in a new world created within the mind of the now ascended Avatar, where several heroes would find themselves as splintered aspects of that heroic figure.

The game was announced in 2003 with a 2004 release date. Despite being playable at E3 2004 and still set for launch that fall, Electronic Arts cancelled the project to focus on supporting Ultima Online instead. This also led to EA closing the doors on Origin Systems, the studio behind the Ultima series.

title: EpicDuel
description: EpicDuel is a free to play browser MMORPG featuring PvP (Player vs Player) combat. Turn fantasy into reality by creating your custom character to fight your friends in turn-based real time strategy battles. And the best RPG gets better with new releases launching every week, so stay tuned to the Design Notes for behind-the-scenes MMO information and become the most epic dueler in all of EpicDuel!

title: Twin Tiger Shark
description: Twin Tiger Shark is a tribute to arcade vertical shoot-'em-ups, released for OUYA and Xbox 360 (via Indie games store)

title: Battlepillars
description: A strategy game featuring caterpillars.

title: Platdude in Space
description: Platdude kicks off an interstellar mission in this space-based platformer.

title: Farsh
description: A puzzle game where players traverse floating platforms by rolling and unrolling a carpet.

title: Sqrxz 4: Cold Cash
description: The fourth entry in the Sqrxz remake series.

title: Heart Forth, Alicia
description:
Heart Forth, Alicia is a Metroidvania RPG about a young wizard pursued by a terror in the sky.

On the night of your coming of age trial, the sky rains fire over your village, scorching everything in its path. Soon, you’re catapulted into an ongoing war between the wizards of the forest and the desert army of the West. Desperate to reunite with your loved ones, you embark on a journey across the landscapes of a beautiful but threatening world, sculpted by the pulsing violence of its past.

At this game's core is an ode to the classics. Remember the electrifying gameplay of Castlevania: Symphony of the Night, the devious dungeons of the Zelda series, and the rich, more serious narrative of Xenogears or Final Fantasy Tactics?

Heart Forth, Alicia brings a modern take on a beloved genre, combining the tight gameplay from the classic action platformers with an epic and serious narrative akin to the iconic '90s RPGs.

title: Space Horse
description: A PC game inspired by M.U.L.E for the Atari 400/800

title: Where am I?
description:
Created in 48 hours for the Ludum Dare 24 game jam with the theme of Evolution.

It is a psychological horror game by Agent Parsec, creator of Slender: The Eight Pages.

title: PureSim Baseball
description: Hardcore baseball simulation game that was released in 2002 for PC

title: Volt: Battery on the Loose
description: You were on the way to a recycling process when fortunately for you - and unfortunately for the environment - you accidentally ran off. Now your goal is to escape from the facility, which is an extremely difficult task due to the fact that you are a battery without legs.

title: That Trivia Game
description: Trivia quiz game with support for up to 4 players.

title: R/C Helicopter: Indoor Flight Simulation
description:
RC Helicopter Indoor Adventure is a RC helicopter flight simulation. You have to navigate your way through rooms, hallways and corridors collecting points to gain access to bigger and faster helicopters.

There are no enemies, just you, rc helicopter, ticking time and some obstacles. There are 2 game modes: challenge and adventure. Challenge contains missions and in adventure you have to collect stars.

title: GiDon Duet
description: Soar through intergalactic obstacle courses as the intrepid shooting star: grasp for the heavens as you come to learn of yourself and your universe, and let familiarity breed perfection. Don't stop there though–use the course editor to create galaxies of your own and share them with the world. Experience the joy of gliding through space to the euphoric beat of your own rhythm.

title: Echelon: Explore, Discover and Eliminate
description: Echelon is an old-school, straightforward RTS game developed by Amnesty Visual and released in 1998 by Arena Games for Windows.

title: La Grande Armee at Austerlitz
description: A PC strategy game set in the 19th century

title: Man of Prey
description: A tactical strategy game with some RTS and RPG elements.

title: Shard
description: Shard is an odyssey that fractures classical platforming. It is an independent game in development by Roger Hanna and Anita Tung.

title: Dark Deception
description: A first-person horror game by indie developer Glowstick Games. The player must run through a maze of corridors, collecting shards and avoiding giant knife-wielding toy monkeys, in a decidedly Pac-Man-like fashion.

title: Star Wars: Droids - The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO
description: Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO is an action computer game based on the 1985-1986 cartoon series.

title: SoundSelf
description: You use your voice to explore a hypnotic world of sounds and visuals that feel like they are emerging directly from your body. Each tone will navigate you through strobing tunnels-of-light, impossible shapes, and into a meditative trance.

title: Doggins
description: Enter the dream world of a terrier and conquer an evil squirrel's puzzles.

title: Space Explorers
description: An astronaut awakes after blacking out on a space mission gone awry, in a world where no one recognizes him.

title: MSI Electric City: Core Assault
description: Rediscover MSI Electric City as you pilot a fighter ship with the mission to defend the city. Maneuver and blast away the enemy swarm in this VR bullet hell arcade shoot ’em up.

title: Maggie's Movies - Camera, Action!
description: Help me follow my dream and become a movie director!

title: Spy of Deimos
description: Take control of Greg, an intergalactic spy who possesses the newest teleportation technology. Your mission is to espionage Sorova, an illegal company which has been trying to build a forbidden weapon to destroy the earth.

title: AddForce
description: Dear fellow Players, Please do not purchase the game anymore because it will become free anytime soon! If you have already purchased it, thanks a million. I do hope you liked it!

title: IonAxxia
description: ionAXXIA is a classic space-shooter that uniquely plays the same with mouse, controller, and touch-screen through pioneering software tech. Dodge, weave, spin, shoot. Use a planet's gravity for a speed slingshot, or draw your pursuer into a fatal collision with an explosive asteroid. This is real gameplay, dependent on reactions and skilful execution, that plays the same on your Windows tablet or phone as it does on your desktop or Steam Link.

title: Death Train VR
description: WARNING: For safety reasons, uninstall this game during parties or events where uninitiated players have access to it. Death Train VR is not recommended without professional supervision.

title: Regions of Ruin
description: Regions of Ruin is a 2D pixel side-scrolling RPG with town-building, where you explore, fight and build into an open world that progressively challenges you and your settlement, and threatens the extinction of the dwarven race.

title: Heli-Commando 2017
description: Heli-Commando 2017 is a retro arcade helicopter game in C64 style like the games in the 80s. Fly a helicopter and rescue mens, cats and collect diamonds and many more types of several objects to gather the highscore of the game.

title: Pizza Hunt! How to Hunt Pizza (And Not Die Doing It)
description: Pizza Hunt! How to hunt pizza (And Not Die Doing It), also known as Pizza Hunt! HTHP (ANDDI) for short, is a simple yet challenging platformer game. You are ANDDI, a pizza huntsman who hunts pizza for his village. Journey through the forest to collect every pizza in existence.

title: Valnir Rok
description: Valnir Rok is a multiplayer survival roleplaying game in a Viking setting with quests by bestselling author Giles Kristian. Explore a huge open world, craft items, cook meals, build houses and found clan cities. Raid other clans or place bounties. Pray to the gods and survive.

title: Elf-World: Three Kingdoms
description: This is a RPG game of training multi heros , you could collect as many as forty generals to fight together , you would unlock more generals under attacking city and develop it ,Collect special weapons from special events。co-ordinate the different generals to beat the boss .

title: The Caribbean Sail
description: An 8-bit adventure about sailing the Atlantic Ocean - Inspired by the Oregon Trail.

title: CubeWorks
description: CubeWorks is a virtual reality strategy & puzzle game using a custom VR interface to challenge the your spatial problem solving abilities. Players must rely on a complete 360-degree manipulation of objects in fully immersive three-dimensional world as they advance through the game and strive to reach the highest scores.

title: World of Castles
description: World of Castles is a medieval themed online action-strategy game, featuring unique combinations of modular castle construction, taking siege to other player castles, and commanding marshals who themselves lead armies that number in the hundreds. You can even take direct control of a marshal and actively participate in siege battles from first-person view.

title: Little Kite
description: The game about one tragic evening in an unsuccessful family, when emotions and tensions are simply too high to manage.

title: Deadly Animal Duel
description:
Deadly Animal Duel is local multiplayer, friendship wrecking, brawl game.
Challenge a friend you don't like to a local duel and make them suffer and experience agony and torment only this game can grant!

title: Battlecruiser Millennium
description: The successor to the volatile Battlecruiser 3000AD game by Derek Smart.

title: Penning: The Tropical Penguin
description: Penning is a cutesy platforming game for PC.

title: Monobeno
description: This was a story about humans and monsters, disease and haunting, and the past and the future. It leads you to the unusual traditional Japanese culture.

title: Monster Truck Rumble
description: A monster truck game featuring four different play modes at a budget price

title: Grief
description: Grief is a short 5-10mn game I made a few years back. It's about the experience of that very alien feeling we all go through at some point in our life.

title: Farland Symphony
description: A spin-off title in the Farland Story RPG franchise.

title: Panorama Toh
description:
Panorama Toh (ぱのらま島 "Panorama Island"), released by Nihon Falcom for the NEC PC-8801 computer in 1983, departed from the standard RPG formula in various ways. It combined RPG gameplay with real-time combat, combined fantasy with sci-fi elements, and introduced survival mechanics.

The game was designed by Yoshio Kiya, this was possibly the first action RPG. These innovative ideas about RPG design departed significantly from the turn-based norm at the time. It introduced real-time combat, sci-fi elements, a persistent open world with day-night cycle, and survival mechanics. This was a precursor to Falcom's seminal action RPG franchise, Dragon Slayer. In 1984, he would go on to create Nihon Falcom's Dragon Slayer franchise, which laid the foundations for the real-time, action RPG genre.

title: Asteka
description:
Asteka (アステカ) is an early graphical adventure game that was created by Tsuneyuki Miyamoto at Nihon Falcom. The title was initially released for the NEC PC-88 and was later ported to other Japanese computers. While exploring the Palenque ruins in southern Mexico, the player takes the role of an archeologist where they use the game's katakana text parser to interact with the world and solve puzzles. The game was technically impressive for its time due to how quickly it could load new images, similar to Falcom's Demons Ring, and for its use of digitized photographs for some of its graphics.

Asteka was most likely released on April 13, 1985 according to early advertisements. However, even Falcom contradicts itself on the title's exact publication date. Falcom's official corporate timeline on their website says Asteka was released in February 1985 while their 2017 pop-up museum, along with the Falcom Chronicle anniversary book, claims it was released on April 10, 1984.

A direct sequel to Asteka was released in 1986 called Temple of the Sun: Asteka II, also known as Tombs & Treasure in North America.

title: Norn9: Last Era
description:
Fandisc for Norn9. Contains three story parts:

1) Concerto
Two-part epilogue stories for each couple.

2) Fuga
The events of the original Norn9 from the love interests' perspective.

3) Fantasia
A what-if storyline that takes place in a universe where the heroines didn't experience romance.

title: Platdude in the Endless Forest
description:
Platdude is having an evening stroll, but there are dangerous creatures lurking outside.
Luckily he knows that the blue spheres can be used to get rid of deadly enemy, but what to do about all the spikes?!.

title: Platdude in the Spirit Collector
description: Platdude attempts to lure ghosts into traps in a haunted mansion.

title: Exodus Guilty Vol. 3 Future
description: The third volume of the Interactive DVD edition of Exodus Guilty by Abel Software.

description: Slashers: The Power Battle is a weapon-based fantasy 2D fighting game. It is the sequel to the Game Boy Advance title "Dual Blades".

title: Farland Story: Kyoushin no Miyako
description: The eighth entry in the Farland Story series.

description: PokéTouch is a Pokémon-themed typing tutor for mobile platforms and Windows PCs. It is available only via license to schools and other educational establishments in Japan.

title: Farland Story: Juuou no Akashi
description: The seventh entry in the Farland Story series.

title: Open Kart
description: A serious simulation of real world go-kart racing

title: Magic Rampage
description: Action RPG

title: WhiteWash
description: Relaxing and Healing Hand-Drawn Puzzle Game

title: Mummy Maze Deluxe
description: A puzzle game developed by PopCap Games.

title: Fort Defense: North Menace
description: Fort Defense is back with refined gameplay and more levels.

title: Dethroned
description: Unleash your inner ruler in Dethroned - an army-building roguelike with short runs, tactical but dynamic fights and infinite possibilities. Choose a mage, hone unique abilities, hunt for spells and artifacts. Explore an unpredictable world, grow influence and forge alliances to reclaim the throne.

title: B-17 Gunner: Air War Over Germany
description: An arcade style rail shooter where you man the gunner position of a B-17 Bomber.

description: A Unity, web-based game of flying down an endless corridor of neon wire-meshes and geometrical shapes.

description: A game for tablets and smartphones where you experience life as a shark, earning money and a high score by eating fish and unaware swimmers and creating combo chains.

title: Puppy Luv Adventures
description: Puppy Luv Adventures is a PC-exclusive entry in the Puppy Luv franchise.

title: Game Room
description: Game Room is a virtual game room where you can play checkers, darts, air hockey, billiards, pinball, snake, and arkanoid. Explore the space from the first person, enjoy classic games, and beat your records

title: Yahtzee Adventures
description: Go on an adventure while playing Yahtzee with people from all over the world.

title: The Last Chapter of Man
description: A pandemic simulator on a virtual globe, modelled with real-world population density, where the player must control the spread to keep the "fire" alive.

title: Razor Global Domination Pro Tour
description: A new freestyle scooter game for the new console trio developed by Renegade Kid in partnership with Razor licensee Scarab Entertainment. The game was supposedly canceled due to publisher issues.

title: Bad Smell
description: A top-down shooter for PC and Mac.

title: Wallaby!! Usagi no Kuni no Kangaroo Race
description: In this game the player bets on races. The twist is, the racers are wallabies. They also have rabbits in their pouches. The game takes place in a world largely inhabited by the said rabbits, but there are other animals, such as koalas who serve as bookmakers. The game also features managerial elements, as the players must manage their racers. The player can choose to play as one of four rabbits and name them. The racing itself is non-interactive, the only option being to change focus from one wallaby to another. The player can watch a race whether they've made a bet or not.

title: Peacekeeper
description: An open world MMORPG, designed around 4 floating regions. Developed by Celant Interactive. Currently in closed alpha

title: Blade Kitten: Dirty Angels
description: Blade Kitten: Dirty Angels is a run-and-gun spinoff of the Blade Kitten video game/comic series.

title: ReVeN
description: ReVeN is a side-scrolling sci-fi action-adventure inspired by the Metroid series.

title: Aima Online
description: Embark on an epic adventure in Aima, a 3D side-scrolling MMORPG. Choose your character from over five unique classes, including the Swordsman, Runeblader, and Assassin. While each class is gender-specific, you have the freedom to customize your character's colors and appearance extensively. Unlock new moves, skills, and abilities to perform longer combos and unleash devastating attacks. Explore diverse dungeons in teams, collaborating to layer skills and conquer monstrous bosses. Join a guild, test your mettle in PvP battles, and unlock Guardian transformations for your character.

title: Kilgazar
description:
Kilgazar's army has captured your village! It's time to take matters into your own hands! Battle your way through hordes of enemies. Learn and use powerful magic spells. Infiltrate the fortress to pass through the gateway to the dark underworld. Can you defeat the demon lord, Kilgazar, and free the land from his grasp?

Kilgazar is a turn-based strategy roguelike that pits you against hordes of enemies. Designed to play like a board game, it features a streamlined interface that makes the game deceptively simple to play while presenting a challenge to players. Blending strategy, planning, and a bit of luck, it takes more than sheer aggression to make it to the end and defeat the demon lord Kilgazar.

title: Astrobase Command
description: A sandbox space station-building game.

title: Glacier Blast
description: Puzzle game for Windows 8

title: Celtic Heroes
description: Are you looking for that classic MMORPG vibe? Whether you're a minmaxer strategizing every detail for maximum efficiency, a savvy fashion collector in search of the most stunning outfits, or even someone who enjoys the journey of casual leveling, Celtic Heroes opens its gates to you!

title: Intruder
description: A home invasion thriller

title: Tottemo E Mahjong Plus
description: An expanded version of the 2012 PS Vita title, developed and published by Arc System Works. It retains the simple Mahjong gameplay while adding new characters, as well as Free Match and Challenge modes. The Arcade mode also features individual stories for each girl.

title: Master of Epic
description: An MMORPG released only in Japan.

title: Mermaid Swamp
description: This is a remake of the original game that adds new art, upgraded graphics, Japanese voice acting, reworked puzzles, and various quality of life and gameplay improvements.

title: Paranoiac
description: Paranoiac is a freeware horror adventure game by Uri made in WOLF RPG Editor.

title: Sky is Arrows
description:
Welcome to Sky Is Arrows, a captivating and intricate fantasy world filled with heroes, epic battles, treacherous exploration, deadly traps, and the ever-looming threat of permanent death. Prepare yourself for a thrilling journey where you must marshal your armies, safeguard your castle against relentless attackers, and embark on a quest to empower your hero to unimaginable heights. Will you have what it takes to vanquish all who stand in your path?

Immerse yourself in a realm brimming with dark secrets and enigmatic locales. Each Act of the game is designed to offer a unique and unpredictable experience, ensuring that no playthrough is ever the same. Venture forth, for beyond the shadows lie ancient graveyards, mysterious shrines, and an array of enticing item and gold chests awaiting your discovery.

As you progress, your hero will grow in strength and prowess. Strategically allocate skill points to enhance your hero’s attributes, shaping them into a formidable warrior capable of decimating hordes of foes. Alternatively, focus on honing a particular spell to unearth its true potential, unleashing devastating powers that will leave your enemies in awe.

Beware, for the world of Sky Is Arrows is relentless. The challenge steadily intensifies over time, and as you push forward, the game grows increasingly difficult. Strengthen your hero to face the ultimate showdown against the formidable final boss or risk succumbing to the overwhelming onslaught of enemy heroes and their augmented armies.

title: Sangoku Hime: Ransei, Tenka Sanbun no Kei
Sengoku Hime 4: Souhai Hyakkei, Hana Mamoru Chikai
description: SystemSoft Alpha once again returns to the little known era of Japanese history where the battlefields were dominated by cute girls with brightly colored hair.

title: Rapid Assault
description: Rapid Assault is a first person vehicular combat game by Synthetic Dimensions.

title: Space Live: Advent of the Net Idols
description: Humanity abandoned reality and decided to reside in Net Space. Net Space is divided into a number of factions, and every four years, they hold a concert for control of all the Spaces. With such high stakes at play, the heated battle between Space Idols shall commence!

title: USA Racer
description:
A clandestine group has been organizing illegal street races in the USA for more than 50 years. What started as a fun event has grown into an annual contest for cash and glory. Only six are given a chance to prove their worth.

US Racer contains 11 tracks in different locations across the USA. Players can race in cities such as Los Angeles, New York or Washington DC or can take part in a race through the Grand Canyon or Yellowstone. Next to Time Trial and Single Race, the Tournament is the main event. It has been split up in three sections: Park Trial, City Trial and US Race. After completing a section, the next one is opened up.

The tracks contain obstacles and jumps. Enemies will try to push other cars off the road, and the police also make an appearance. Scattered around the tracks are power-ups that repair the car, provide boost or cash. The money can be used to upgrade the car, repair it or buy boost prior to the race. After completing an entire tournament with a certain car, an alternate vehicle becomes available for that character.

In the Windows version two-player duels are available over LAN or TCP/IP. Players can either go head-to-head or play a game of Cop vs. Racer.

title: Astérix & Obelix Take on Caesar
description: Astérix & Obelix Take on Caesar is an action video game based on the film of the same name.

title: Life Is Strange 2
description: Life Is Strange 2 is an episodic adventure game played from a third-person perspective. Players control Sean Diaz, a teenager on the run with his younger brother Daniel after a tragic incident forces them to flee their home in Seattle. The game uses a road trip structure inspired by films like Into the Wild and Stand By Me, with each episode set in a new location along the US West Coast. Sean must make choices that affect both the story's branching paths and Daniel's developing morality and behavior. The game explores themes of family, brotherhood, and contemporary social issues through its narrative-driven gameplay.

title: Murder in a Wheel
description: A Locked Room Mystery Story: Roderick, Lady Blackwin's beloved Hamster, was murdered. It is up to you to solve the crime and find the killer.

title: Friday: Death to Arthur Yahtzee
description:
This is graphical point-and-click adventure with simple original engine. The game, like most 3rd Person adventure games, consists of action buttons which you use to interact with your surrounding. Simple as it is, it has your standard Look, Use, Talk, Inventory features.

You are Arthur Yahtzee, a dole-bludger living in Los Angeles, who is credited with one major event - when the local Federal Research Institute started spawning hideous mutants, he single-handedly stopped them. Now, another branch of FRI in Chicago are spawning more mutants, and this time they're after YOU...

title: The Tuttles: Madcap Misadventures
description: The Tuttles Madcap Misadventures is a hilarious arcade adventure game about a thoroughly modern family trying to bond on a road trip to the Alamo. Beautifully detailed art and wonderfully silly situations bring this familiar story to the Interactive age.

title: Forever Growing Garden
description: Some hardware companies often published their own games in order to bundle them with their hardware (when they couldn't get enough big-name games to sign with them). This is one such product. Forever growing garden's gameplay consists of selecting seeds, etc. and taking care of them in order to later sell your crops on the market and flowershop (were you can also make flower-arrangements, etc.) the game is aimed at kids, so everything from the interface to the objectives are kept very simple and straight-forward. Also the game is filled with hot-spots that start animations or sound effects.

title: Risk: The Game of Global Domination
description: Designed especially for desktop and tablet PC, the new, officially licensed version of RISK, the classic game of strategy and conquest. Features a beautifully rendered digital game board, animated dice, cards and armies that recreate the rivalry, competition and tension of the classic Hasbro board game.

title: Nikoli no Puzzle 4: Sudoku
description: The power of Nikoli's sudoku and the power of the PlayStation 4 collide in this Japanese launch release.

title: Maverick Bird
description: A Flappy Bird inspired game by Terry Cavanagh.

title: Jarokn Cricket 2
description: Jarokn Cricket 2 is the PC-based sequel to the Android cricket game Jarokn Cricket, both created by Jarokn Games.

title: The Stadium Project
description: The Stadium Project is a simplistic stadium building game.

title: Of the Red, the Light, and the Ayakashi Tsuzuri
description: A modern Japanese-style fantasy story involving Yue, a young boy born and raised at a shrine, and his friendship with the "Ayakashi" spirits. HaccaWorks* presents a mysterious, spiritual adventure game.

title: Emmy: The Funny Game
description: Emmy: The Funny Game is an early eroge where the player is challenged to persuade the titular girl strip off her clothes.

title: Napoleon 1813
description: A combination turn based strategy game with real time battles depicting Napoleon's campaign.

title: Man in a Maze
description: Unity video game from SmallGreenHill for PC, iOS and Mac.

title: FX Eleven
description: Top Eleven is a football manager simulation for the iPhone.

title: Romans From Mars
description: Tower defense.

title: Galactic Wars
description: a 8bit Space shooter in Pico 8

title: Skydive!
description: Skydive at exotic locations and compete in challenges, like diving through rings.

title: Farm Town
description: A new game from CIE studios. It will be online for PC and XBox Live.

title: Microsoft Golf 1999 Edition
description:
A golf simulation game featuring 7 courses and 18 golf clubs. Players can customize their golfer and choose different swing and click methods.
The multiplayer had support for Microsoft's Internet Gaming Zone as well.

title: Daemon Vector
description: This action RPG features gothic-styled slashing combat as a sinister strain of the Black Plague has brought to life Medieval Europe's decaying dead. The story traces back to the 14th century when Marco Polo traveled to Europe from the Far East. A seal from ancient China was broken, awakening the monster within, which brought one of the darkest periods of the human history when Black Death covered Europe with horror. A terrible disaster without cause unveils the 3D action adventure of Daemon Vector. Choose from one of the many playable characters to battle against the the daemons that have escaped from the seal. There are more than 20 stages in 6 areas.

title: Magicoal
description:
The boy Rhun and the girl Melvy live in a quiet forest village, both studying the art of magic. They enjoy a peaceful life, learning the secrets of the spirits and magical creatures populating the area. But on one fateful night, everything changes. A horde of goblins invades the village, burning it down. And it looks like the local church is in cohorts with a powerful demon bent on destruction! Before the heroes can realize what is happening, they are forced to escape into the forest, with only their magical powers at their side...

Magicoal is a "pseudo-RPG", i.e. an action-adventure with some minor RPG elements (money, items, etc.), but without an experience system of any kind. It can be played in two-player cooperative mode, controlling Rhun and Melvy, or as a single-player game, choosing one of them and letting the computer AI control the other. The player(s) can switch between the two at any time.

Most of the game is dedicated to exploring top-down areas populated by enemies, and dealing with them in action-based combat, primarily relying on magical spells. While some of the spells have unlimited use, others must be "refilled" with special items found or dropped by the enemies. Rhun and Melvy learn spells unique to each character, of various elemental affinities and general usage (offensive, support, etc.). Money can be collected from enemies as well and then used in shops to buy items.

title: Dragoon: The Battles of Frederick the Great
description: An isometeric strategy wargame focusing on Fredrick the Great's campaign during the Seven Year War in the 18th century.

title: Arcanists
description: Customise your own unique Arcanist and engage in magical duels against thousands of other players. Tailor your spellbook to your own playing style from a vast selection of spells. Summon minions to do your bidding and ride atop powerful familiars.

title: Microsoft Baseball 3D 1998 Edition
description: An arcade style baseball game featuring robust graphics for the time

title: Sierra Pro Pilot 98: The Complete Flight Simulator
description: This is the first edition in the Pro Pilot civilian flight simulation series. The scenery is North America and Europe, and both VFR/IFR can be used with AI Air traffic controllers. The included aircraft are: Cessna Skyhawk 172P, 172R, CitationJet 525, Beechcraft Bonanza V35, Baron B58, and Super King Air B200.

title: Spanking Runners
description: Arcade combat racer developed by K-D Lab (now KD Vision) for the PC. Notably, it features a tactical, turn-based mode for "people who do not have good reflexes."

title: SpeedBoat Attack
description: SpeedBoat Attack is the second game that criterion studios made. You're racing against AI boats and racing against the time.

title: The Untouchable
description: Combat-style fighting game developed by Creative Edge and published by Tiburon Interactive Publishing.

title: Man of War
description: Man of War recreates wood ship battles during the American Revolution to the Napoleonic Wars.

title: Pro Yakyuu World Stadium
description: World Stadium is a version of Family Stadium for non-Nintendo platforms, appearing on the PC Engine and in arcades.

title: Silent Heroes: Elite Troups of WWII
description: Silent Heroes: Elite Troops of WWII is a stand-alone game based on Soldiers: Heroes of World War II engine and more orientated on Direct Control than on group control like Faces of War does. Player commands a group of 6 soviet saboteurs who must complete extremely hard missions at the rear of the German army. The game features 10 saboteurs mission assembled into one story-driven campaign with player changing the course of war by destroying enemy radar installations, kidnapping enemy officers and hunting down legendary German Tigers. The game is fully orientated on single player campaign and doesn't feature any multiplayer modes.

title: Quest fo Karma
description: Quest fo Karma is an edducational game for PC.

title: Flyboys Squadron
description: Flyboys Squadron is a WWI action flight simulator. It presents a single player campaign and an MMO module, which requires a monthly fee.

title: Gunhouse
description: Players protect their house by any means necessary, as relentless hordes of alien invaders seek to devour the innocent little orphans inside in this take on the tower defense genre.

title: The Rapture is Here and You will be Forcibly Removed from Your Home
description: The Rapture Is Here And You Will Be Forcibly Removed From Your Home is a game created by Connor Sherlock. Each game gives around 20 minutes to look around and experience the rapture of earth. Inspired by H. P. Lovecraft.

title: ABC Monday Night Football '98
description: ABC Sports MNF 98 is the sophomore effort by ABC Sports and OT Sports.

title: Tony La Russa Baseball 4
description: The final entry in Stormfront Studios' series of baseball simulation games.

title: R.B.I. Baseball 14
description: Major League Baseball is getting into the video game business with the release of a new game that says "RBI Baseball" right on the (digital) cover.

title: Spy Daisakusen
description: One of the first Japanese RPG's, and the first game based on the Mission: Impossible franchise. It was notable for replacing the fantasy setting of traditional RPG's with a modern setting.

title: Vietcong: Red Dawn
description: Second expansion game to the original Vietcong.

title: Dinothawr
description: In this block-pushing puzzle game, players control a dinosaur whose goal is to rescue other dinosaurs who have been trapped in ice.

title: British Open Championship Golf
description: Rex Bradford, the man who came up with the power swing bar, returns for the first time in British Open Championship Golf with exclusive rights to the British Open course and tournament.

title: Star Stealing Prince
description: Star Stealing Prince is a freeware fantasy RPG created with RPG Maker VX by Ronove (or known as Black Birds of Rye on the official site).

title: Battle Bears -1
description: Game prequel to Battle Bears: Zombies.

title: Q!Zone
description:
Q!Zone is an authorized collection of maps for Quake by WizardWorks. It was released in 1996. It would later be bundled with both the original Quake and the Malice total conversion in the form of the Resurrection Pack for Quake compilation, distributed by GT Interactive in 1998.

The new campaign is simply a collection of 26 new single-player levels sprawled over three new episodes, plus a series of deathmatch/capture the flag maps.

title: War of Omens
description: War of Omens is a card game combining deck-builder and CCG mechanics, featuring fast, strategic play and three different playable factions.

title: SoulTrap
description: SoulTrap is a 3D platform game that takes place inside the mind of the main character of the game: Malcolm West. The fears and anxieties of Malcolm West are represented by strange often moving platform structures high in the sky. The player has to jump from platform to platform, shooting phobias taking the form of enemies and outwitting obstacles that he comes across. The game comes with 11 levels with each their own graphical theme. The player can find various weapons such as a magical axe, a .45 automatic and a grenade launcher. There are also power-ups that allow the player to replenish health and ammunition. The game allows the use of both first person and third person camera angles.

title: Huygen's Disclosure
description: An action adventure game that takes you to an alien world of mystery and hidden dangers.

title: Lenna's Inception
description:
Explore a dangerous island filled with dungeons, and defeat the eight archangels to bring order to a glitched-out kingdom in this top-down Zelda-like action-adventure game. Playable in 8-bit and 32-bit pixel art styles! 
 
Features 
- Team up with a friend. Make peace with Shadow Lenna to enjoy the game in local co-op multiplayer! 
- Play again (and again). With two graphical styles, multiple endings, multiple boss forms, and procedural generation, you won’t see everything in a single playthrough! 
- Challenge yourself. Speed through the daily challenge dungeon with no sword, with only three hearts, or without taking a single hit. Show off a GIF of your playthrough on the connected leaderboard afterwards! 
- Recruit companions. Will you choose Henrietta, the free-range chicken with a vendetta, or perhaps Gourdon, the sentient pumpkin? (4 to discover)

title: Infocom Classic Text Adventure Masterpieces
description: Classic Text Adventure Masterpieces is a compilation of 33 Infocom games. In addition, six award-winning amateur adventures are included as well as some old Infocom staff e-mail.

title: Hoyle Blackjack
description: A Sierra made blackjack game & craps PC game

title: Mind Grind
description: A puzzle/quiz style game intended to challenge players' reflexes as well as their minds.

title: Wizardry Gold
description: An enhanced version of Wizardry VII with updated graphics, voice acting, and a new interface.

title: Fantasy Realm Online
description: A sandbox MMORPG for Windows and Linux, set in the world of Moon Haven.

title: Tracer
description:
A neon, heart pounding, endless arcade racer!

Race down the gauntlet, faster and faster! How far, and how fast, can you go before you crash?

title: Babysitter Bloodbath
description:
"They locked him up and threw away the key!"

For 22 years Neokalus Burr has stared at an empty wall in the bowels of Monroe State Mental Hospital. But tonight he's escaped to continue his blood soaked murder rampage! It's also your first night babysitting

title: STCC 2: The Game
description: DLC 'Sequel' to STCC - The Game, this is an updated add-on to Race 07.

title: Guy vs. The Wicked and Nefarious Land
description: Guy vs The Wicked and Nefarious Land is a fast-paced dungeon crawler where you must guide Guy through 5 dungeons filled with evil creatures, traps, and pop culture references.

title: Disney City Girl
description: With suitcase in hand, it's time to leave your small-town life behind and head to the big city to make your dreams come true! Do you have what it takes to skyrocket to stardom? In the spirit of Sorority Life, players will engage in a stylish and aspirational virtual world, working their way through careers paths, apartment upgrades, daily catwalks, and fashion galore. From a grungy studio to a Park Avenue penthouse, from overworked intern to successful CEO, from country bumpkin to glamour girl, City Girl will keep players coming back again and again!

title: Teleportower Plus
description: Teleportower is a platformer / puzzle game. In each stage, the protagonist can teleport between each "tower" or screen in order to progress, with the aim of getting the gold crystal. 100 levels in total, along with a level editor and many custom stages (some of which come with the download). It is free, developed by "kaho", and can be found here: /~ss1/top.htm

title: Trainz: Settle & Carlisle
description: Standalone add-on for Trainz

title: Reksio i Wehikuł Czasu
description: The fourth part of Rex's Adventures. In this episode we travel through time and space.

title: Battle Bears Gold
description: Previously known as Battle Bears Royale, compete with your friends across vibrant sci-fi maps across multiple game modes. Choose from 11 unique classes, with thousands of loadout combinations to master.

title: Infected: The Twin Vaccine
description: A hidden object game based around a zombie story.

title: Doki Doki Card League
description: Doki Doki Card League is a turn based, single player, manga card battle, strategy game for baseball enthusiasts.

title: Tsuyokiss 3gakki
description: A further retelling of Tsuyokiss and Tsuyokiss 2gakki, takes place a few months after Celeb has transferred to Leo's class (but before the game enters any routes).

title: Tsuyokiss 2gakki
description: A retelling of Tsuyokiss which takes place a few months after Otome has started living together with Leo (before the game enters any routes) and introduces the transfer student, Celeb, who joined Leo's class.

title: Yoostar
description: Yoostar is a "film karaoke" game that lets players act out scenes from their favorite movies.

title: The Smiling, Proud Wanderer 2
description: Based on Louis Cha's novel, The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, this PC game is a continuation of the novel's storyline.

title: Ima Sugu Onii-chan ni Imouto da tte Iitai!
description: Ima Sugu Onii-chan ni Imouto da tte Iitai! is a Japanese visual novel developed by fairys, taking place before the events of Love, Elections, & Chocolate! and revolves around the protagonist Rikuto Mitani, whose father remarried a woman who already has a daughter.

title: Lovely Quest
description: Visual novel about the one man Lovely Smile Committee, and its search to find examples of pure love.

title: Rally Poland
description: Polish Rally is the first native arcade racing game. In the game we have a 4 car models and over 170 km of nicely done tracks.

title: Phone Story
description: Phone Story is a game for smartphone devices that attempts to provoke a critical reflection on its own technological platform. Under the shiny surface of our electronic gadgets, behind its polished interface, hides the product of a troubling supply chain that stretches across the globe. Phone Story represents this process with four educational games that make the player symbolically complicit in coltan extraction in Congo, outsourced labor in China, e-waste in Pakistan and gadget consumerism in the West.

title: Samantha Swift and the Mystery From Atlantis
Microsoft Bingo
description: Microsoft Bingo is a free-to-play, microtransaction- and ad-supported bingo game that has players level up and unlock new areas as they play shared online games of bingo.

title: Age of Storm: Kingdom Under Fire Online
description: Age of Storm: Kingdom Under Fire Online is an MOBA title set in the Kingdom Under Fire universe.

title: Bubsy 3D: Bubsy Visits the James Turrell Retrospective
description: A web-based 3D experience and homage to both art and Bubsy.

title: Airport Firefighter Simulator
description: A simulation game where fires must be put out at the airport.

title: Proving Ground 2014
description: A driving simulator with multiple vehicles and tracks, and real vehicle dynamics and physics e.g. ABS, traction control, stability control, etc.

title: Stellavanity: Prelude to the Destined Calamity
description: A STG from TRIS-GRAM, Stellavanity has players fight through seven increasingly difficult stages of bullet hell.

title: Santa Tracker
description: Track Santa's flight and play games in your browser and on Android.

title: Tecmo World Cup Super Soccer
description: Tecmo World Cup Super Soccer is quite different from the similarly-named Tecmo World Cup Soccer. In this football (soccer) game players can choose between competing for the World Cup or participating in the Japanese league tournament. Only eight international teams (Brazil, Argentine, Japan, England, France, Spain, Italy, and Germany) are available. Before a match begins players can choose between three general strategies for the team - normal, offensive, or defensive. Weather conditions (normal, rain, or snow) and match length can be selected as well. The game itself is played from a third-person perspective that slightly switches between isometric and top-down depending on the situation.

title: Sanae Challenge!
description: A platform game, you run around the map while fighting and sealing Kedamas and the locations where they spawn.

title: Bistro Boulevard
description: A restaurant simulator.

title: Cinema Tycoon 2: Movie Mania
description: Cinema Tycoon 2: Movie Mania is a cinema simulator.

title: Slingray
description: Multiplayer team-based competitive space hockey inspired by games like Uniball and Subspace

title: Illusion: Ghost Killer
description: Set up six cameras in strategic positions to capture the elusive Jeff the Killer on film.

title: Irem Arcade Hits
description: 18 classic Irem arcade games for PC and Mac.

title: Rofaxan 2089 AD
description: Rofaxan 2089 AD is a space shooter for Xbox 360 and PC

title: Streemerz
description: Streemerz is an 8-bit retro platformer by Arthur Lee for his Action 52 Owns project. First created as a freeware PC game, it was "demade" for the Nintendo Entertainment System.

title: HeroWarz
description:
HeroWarz is the Ultimate action RPG where you select and cultivate unique heroes to build your own personal assault force. Get ready for the most addicting, fast-paced, action-packed online gaming experience!

The Korean servers were shutdown in October 2017.
The game was released briefly in North America through KOG Games before being shutdown in Match 2017.
The game had releases planned in Japan through Sega and in China through NetEase but both versions were shutdown before a public release.

In 2019, NetEase working with A.Storm announced a remake titled NightMare Breaker, 超激斗梦境, in China using the same characters with better graphics but slower gameplay.
In 2022, the remake was announced with a 2023 release date in Korea through Nexon under the title Night Walker.

title: Tsuppari Oozumou: Heisei-han
description: An enhanced re-release of the 1987 Tsuppari Oozumou game for Famicom.

title: Fjords
description: Fjords is a pizza-delivery adventure game set in a world made of science.

title: Moonlight Lady
description: An adventure game with animated cutscenes and action-RPG sequences, starring three cutesy anime girls.

title: Fish Face
description: Search for a new face in a unnervingly peaceful fishing experience.

title: Action Fist
description: Action Fist is a side-scrolling game created in the style of mid-90s platform shooters. It was mostly inspired by Gunstar Heroes.

title: 0Space
description: Inspired by “Ender's Game” by Orson Scott Card, 0Space is a small 2-4 player zero gravity death-match game.

title: Project Ion
description:
Project Ion is an MMOFPS/TPS/RPG that is in development since late 2011.
The project is under constant development but has a playable version up all the time.

title: Initial D: Second Stage Typing Game
description: Initial D: Second Stage Typing Game is typing tutorial game for Windows and Macintosh, based on the Initial D driving anime.

title: Tome: Immortal Arena
description: Tome: Immortal Arena is a brawler MOBA built for non-stop action.

title: Silver Ghost
description: A unique hybrid RTS/Action/RPG game first released in 1988. It was the first game by Kure Software Koubou and itnroduced their eventually popular Multiple Character gameplay system that they went on to use in many later games.

title: The Scheme
description: The Scheme is an action RPG released by Bothtec (later known as Quest) for the PC-88 in 1988. It features Metroidvania-style open-world exploration, side-scrolling run & gun shooter combat, and chiptune music by Yuzo Koshiro.

title: Xanadu Scenario II
description: One of the first examples of an expansion pack, this was an additional scenario disk for the action role-playing game Xanadu: Dragon Slayer II.

title: Hover Attack
description: Hover Attack, the definitive version of the robot action game that became a huge hit in 1984 and was ported to various consoles, is now available on STEAM with a port of the original game and an Ultimate Evolution version that dramatically evolves the gameplay with enhanced graphics and sound!

title: J.B. Harold Series #2: Manhattan Requiem - Angels Flying in the Dark
description:
The second game in the J.B. Harold series.

24 year old pianist Sarah Shields was found dead after falling from the 25th floor of her apartment window. The cause of death was a fractured skull from the horrific impact.
